subject: Request: trial runway after build freeze (RetailEdge POC)
messages:
From: Maya Chen <maya@retailedge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Peter Wu <peter.wu@retailedge.com>
Date: 2026-08-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RetailEdge POC: build freeze — need trial runway

Hi Connor,

Quick update from our side — the team hit a blocker during the Rails adapter integration yesterday. There's a schema mismatch in the connector that turned into a hard build freeze. Engineering estimates a 10 business day fix once we re-prioritize, which pushes our demo window out and effectively leaves us mid-POC without enough credits to continue testing.

We were hoping Redwood could provide a short runway (sandbox credits + 2-week trial extension) so we can finish the integration and run the final stability tests. Without that runway we risk missing the internal exec review and losing momentum.

I've attached the integration log that shows the failing request and a short screenshots folder is coming as a follow-up. Our proposed timeline: fix + internal QA by Aug 20, extended demo week of Aug 24-31.

Let me know if you need more technical detail or a short call — Peter and I are available tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Maya Chen
Director of Integrations
RetailEdge

Attachments: integration-log-20260807.txt
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya@retailedge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailEdge POC: build freeze — need trial runway

Thanks for the clear note, Maya — sorry to hear about the blocker. Appreciate the log; that helps.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I want to confirm the exact runway you need (credits + extension length). Can you confirm a token estimate for the remaining tests and if you need any dedicated support from our integration ATP team?
- I've looped Lauren (AM) and Sean (Customer Success) so we can coordinate credits and any hands-on assistance.

From a policy standpoint I can propose a temporary top-up and a two-week extension immediately, but I need formal approval from our credit approver (Lauren or Hannah) for anything > 1,000 sandbox credits. If you can do a quick token estimate (ballpark is fine), I will draft the ask with a short MAP and timeline.

If it helps, I'm available for a 20-minute call today at 11:30 PT to walk through the log with your engineers.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-08T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RetailEdge POC: build freeze — ask for runway/top-up (requesting approval)

Hannah — FYI and approval request. Connor flagged a build freeze for RetailEdge (deal RE-POC-2026-07). Customer reports a connector schema mismatch that paused their Rails integration; they estimate ~10 business days to complete the fix and have asked for sandbox credits plus a 2-week trial extension to finish QA and run the demo.

Proposed support: 2,000 sandbox credits (one-time top-up) and a 14-day trial extension. We would also offer a 1-hour troubleshooting session with our integrations engineer (Sean) to accelerate the fix.

Why this is reasonable: RetailEdge is mid-POC, active exec demo scheduled once integration completes, and they showed consistent usage over the prior two weeks (see HubSpot activity). A small top-up keeps the deal alive and prevents churn of a strategic mid-market prospect.

Attachments: RE-POC-mutual-action-plan.pdf (proposed timeline + tasks)

Connor — can you confirm the customer's token estimate (user provided), then I'll formalize the credit issuance.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-08T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RetailEdge POC: build freeze — ask for runway/top-up (requesting approval)

Approved.

Please proceed with the following:
- Issue 2,000 sandbox credits to RetailEdge (credit code: RE-POC-2K-0808).
- Grant a 14-day trial extension starting Aug 21, 2026.
- Schedule a 60-minute troubleshooting session with Sean (cc'd) within the next 48 hours and mark it as priority.
- Connor, please update HubSpot with the credit code and the new timeline (link to deal in the doc).

Rationale: small, finite cost; high likelihood to convert once the integration is unblocked; good customer health indicators. If they request more than 2K or further extensions, escalate back to me with updated usage and a note from eng.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
